answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks by pricing each identity at its expected reward. Joining requires a deposit the on-chain oracle sizes to a marginal clone's projected payout, refunded only after many clean epochs. Honest workers recover it nearly free, so the deposit costs only sybils: every clone must front what it hopes to earn, and any clone an audit flags, black as sable, is slashed, turning a gale of mass minting into a loss. The lantern of accounting exposes clusters before refunds clear. It holds while deposits price at or above marginal reward and audits catch some clones.
